series_143_arc_milestones.title: Tae Keeps That Frosty Gaze Locked (Ep 58–72)

scenes.narration_speech: When the apocalypse turns Seoul into a feral meat grinder, Tae knows screaming won't save anyone.
Emergency broadcasts spew hollow reassurances while entire districts collapse into fiery, lawless chaos.
Screams echo across the streets as mutated infected violently run down panicked survivors.
A victim desperately fights back, but brute feral strength easily overpowers standard human resistance.
Bloodshot eyes and gaping jaws confirm civilization ended before lunch even arrived.
An endless swarm charges down the asphalt like a tidal wave of nightmare fuel.
State announcements urge everyone to lock their doors and wait for miracles that aren't coming.
Across the shattered skyline, plumes of black smoke mark where organized resistance crumbled.
Military checkpoints collapse under crushing hordes faster than command can issue fresh orders.
High-caliber rounds tear through the frontline beasts, yet the swarm pushes relentlessly forward.
Desperate squad leaders scream for headshots into radios that nobody is answering anymore.
Heavy fire chews up the pavement, cutting down waves without slowing the main tide.
Piercing shrieks rip through the cordons as more infected barrel into point-blank range.
Rabid monstrosities shrug off flesh wounds, driven purely by the urge to consume.
Tae casually sparks up a lighter, watching the chaos with ice in his veins.
Golden flames flicker as he leans back against the wall, utterly unfazed by the apocalypse.
Outside, society drowns in madness; here, he takes a slow, steady drag.
Stepping out onto the bloodstained floor, he observes the carnage with pure disgust.
Cold, calculating eyes scan the alleyway, daring any creature to sprint forward.
He issues a blunt ultimatum: attack all at once, or stop wasting his time.
A survivor swings desperately at charging beasts, struggling to buy another precious second.
Teeth clenched and knuckles white, every swing is fueled by raw survival adrenaline.
The blunt weapon crashes down with everything the defender has left in reserve.
Bone fractures on impact, unleashing a furious blast of dust and splintered wood.
Swept off balance in the narrow corridor, the defender tumbles into lethal danger.
He scrambles backward across the floor, clutching his weapon as shadows loom above.
From behind the barricade, steel mesh is the only fragile barrier keeping predators out.
Tae and his companions peer down from the catwalk, coolly assessing the struggling stranger.
Rapid gunfire rattles the hallway, punching clean through charging infected heads.
A ghoul collapses instantly onto the concrete, snuffed out mid-stride by lethal precision.
Lowering a smoking sidearm, an armed survivor secures the perimeter with ruthless focus.
Sweat drips down furrowed brows as the reality of endless swarms sinks deep.
Another twitching corpse hits the tiles, neutralized before its claws can strike flesh.
Scanning the bloody staircase, the gunman catches his breath and reloads without hesitation.
Tae approaches with steady, measured footsteps, silently evaluating the newcomer's survival grit.
Locked eyes exchange unspoken respect—because in this new world, hesitation guarantees an instant grave.
Tae breaks that deadlocked gaze, calmly raising his hands as intelligence agents search him.
Shadows slice across his face, harboring zero fear of the heavy brass waiting inside.
Cold sweat drips down the director's jaw before the emergency briefing even begins.
The chief presidential advisor watches silently, calculating every possible national disaster.
At the head sits the kingmaker himself, demanding absolute results from this classified meeting.
Facing the nation's shadow rulers would make any ordinary man fold under the pressure.
"Let's begin," the agent announces, cutting through the suffocating tension in the room.
Adjusting his glasses, the presenter prepares to reveal classified doomsday footage.
Bodycam footage from a quarantined coastal patrol vessel flickers onto the primary display.
Panic instantly grips the general's face as chaotic gunfire echoes through the speakers.
The shadow elites leap from their seats in sheer disbelief at the footage.
On-screen, a grotesque abomination confirms the arrival of Project 82-08.
Outside, Seoul basks in oblivious afternoon peace right outside a bustling barbecue restaurant.
The dining hall roars with lively laughter, completely unaware that doomsday is already knocking.
An urgent news bulletin flashes a massive explosion on the Russian border, ignored by everyone.
Tae pours drinks for his childhood crew, celebrating their buddy's mandatory military enlistment.
Nearby, a gang of rowdy, tattooed mobsters noisily takes over the restaurant floor.
Their obnoxious shouting immediately grinds on everyone's last nerve.
The future recruit grins, stuffing his face before harsh army rations take over.
Tactical composure means picking your battles—and loud thugs aren't worth the hassle yet.
Good times with true brothers won't last much longer in this doomed world.
The crew devours the sizzling feast like ravenous beasts before reality hits.
Meanwhile, pop idols dance across the television screen, lighting up the lively dining hall.
Heated debates erupt across the table over who commands the best stage presence.
Tae merely laughs along, soaking in these precious final moments of civilian normalcy.
A radiant smile lights up the room, cherishing loyal friendship before everything burns.
Across the floor, a spilled drink triggers an explosive gangster tantrum.
A terrified waitress bows repeatedly, offering to cover every single dry cleaning fee.
The bald raider licks his lips with predatory entitlement, cornering the helpless worker.
He forcibly grabs her wrist, demanding she sit down and pay emotional damages.
Tae steps in and grips the brute's wrist, daring him to push his luck.
"Back off before this gets ugly," he warns with chilling, deadpan calm.
Tae warned that disaster strikes unseen, beginning with a derelict vessel cutting through black waves.
The coast guard patrol spots the silent drift, completely oblivious to what's lurking aboard.
Protocol demands an immediate search, sending four unsuspecting men straight into the lion's den.
Tactical flashlights sweep over the eerie deck, reporting dead silence to command.
Complaining about the humid night shift, one officer casually peels off his helmet.
Peering down the dark cargo hatch, his casual attitude instantly vanishes into pure terror.
Bloodcurdling screams erupt below deck, echoing straight across the open water.
The backup squad rushes forward, desperately calling out into the shadowed abyss.
They heave their screaming comrade back up, struggling against terrifying dead weight.
But the sight waiting for them freezes the entire team in total disbelief.
An unspeakable abomination has locked its jaws firmly onto their squad leader's face.
Fangs dig deep into flesh, refusing to detach no matter how hard they pull.
Grabbing a tactical hatchet, one furious officer winds up for a brutal strike.
He buries the steel blade into the beast's skull with ruthless force.
The monster crashes against the deck, seemingly dispatched for good.
Sergeant Kim collapses clutching his mutilated face, howling in agonizing pain.
Ragged breathing and torn skin—the squad scrambles frantically to stem the bleeding.
But the mangled creature twitches, baring crimson teeth back at them.
A terrified officer freezes, staring directly into the glowing eyes of absolute insanity.
It unleashes an ungodly shriek, defying every law of basic human biology.
Twisted, muscular limbs propel the abomination forward at terrifying predatory speed.
It lunges straight for their throats with mindless, ravenous fury.
A deafening gunshot rings out, tearing right through the ghoul's skull.
The young officer stares in dazed shock at the smoking barrel.
The grotesque body drops motionless onto the deck plates, leaking dark fluid.
They check in with trembling voices, thinking the nightmare has finally ended.
Command receives a frantic radio report about unauthorized live rounds on deck.
Meanwhile, their injured sergeant continues groaning while clutching his shredded face.
They call for immediate medical extraction, reaching out to steady their commander.
But the moment their hands touch, the sergeant's glazed eyes snap open.
Milky pupils roll forward as a demonic howl ruptures from his throat.
Body camera footage captures the exact second their trusted leader turns rabid.
His fangs sink deep into a crewmate, spreading the relentless contagion instantly.
While that feral infection rips through the ship, Tae clings to peaceful memories before hell broke loose.
Back when brawling over lunch money was the worst problem anyone had to deal with.
Sitting alone inside quiet barracks, reminiscing about simpler times before civilization collapsed.
A swimsuit pinup taped beside his desk. Peak military luxury right there.
Staring through rain-streaked glass, he senses the calm world will not last.
Far away from Tae's base, a heavily armored vault transport races through the stormy darkness.
The escort driver feels an unnatural shudder beneath the chassis. That is never good.
Stepping out into the downpour, his flashlight beam catches a massive spike trap.
He frantically keys his radio, but cold static is the only answer.
A brutal blunt strike shatters his skull, dropping him instantly onto the asphalt.
Headlights slice through the darkness as a dozen armed syndicate vehicles box them in.
The mob enforcer steps forward, calmly ordering his goons to eliminate all witnesses.
No negotiations. Zero mercy.
Grinning raiders brandish nail-studded clubs, storming the stranded escort convoy like ravenous dogs.
A wooden bat obliterates the driver window, smashing the defenseless agent backward.
The escorts scramble to deploy, but get overwhelmed and beaten down immediately.
Striking every vital nerve cluster with surgical savagery—these are not amateur street thugs.
The squad commander shouts for headquarters, right before a lethal spike pierces his forehead.
A lone assassin touches down onto the highway with terrifying precision.
Rising through the storm, he unleashes a lightning slash that sprays crimson everywhere.
A devastating punch shatters the lead guard's face into splintered bone.
The squad captain drops face-first into the mud. Total wipeout.
Panicked survivors empty full pistol magazines, but the assassin dodges like water.
Snatching a fallen guard off the ground, he hoists the body upward effortlessly.
Tae shines his flashlight inside the refrigerated container, expecting contraband, not an arctic meat locker.
Frost coats the interior, but something resting in the back immediately catches his eye.
Look at that pale, frozen face caked in grime and suspicious bite marks.
Tae frowns, wondering why his corrupt boss ordered a haul of frozen corpses.
Carrying expired human cargo across borders makes zero financial sense, even for gangsters.
Deep lacerations cover the skin, looking less like cuts and more like rabid bites.
Outside the truck, an impatient thug pounds loudly on the reinforced metal doors.
Tae snarls back, telling the idiot outside to shut his mouth and wait.
Dealing with jumpy lackeys in the middle of a torrential downpour is exhausting.
The frozen corpse stumbles upright with hollow eyes and decaying jaws agape.
Tae freezes in place, realizing this refrigerated stiff isn't actually dead.
Not even close.
The creature unleashes an ear-piercing screech, snapping its jaws straight at Tae's throat.
It lunges with freakish velocity, moving way too fast for a supposed dead body.
Tae throws a desperate right hook, barely keeping the rabid teeth off him.
No weapons in reach? Tae just uses his heavy smartphone as an improvised blunt club.
He bashes the monster across the skull with brute force and pure adrenaline.
Repeated heavy impacts ring out against bone, driving the raving creature backward.
The monster collapses flat, twitching on the frozen floor of the truck bed.
Tae catches his breath, thinking that nightmare was finally resolved.
A sickening crunch shatters the brief silence behind him.
Classic mistake.
Two more snarling infected tackle him from the shadows of the frost-filled container.
Rotting fangs snap inches from his neck as heavy claws dig into his suit.
Tae unloads rapid hammer fists, violently dislodging the snarling monstrosity.
But staring down two unfeeling predators in a pitch-black steel box is pure suicide.
Tae curses under his breath, realizing this delivery was an absolute death trap.
Outside the rainy warehouse, mobsters wait idly while passing around packs of cigarettes.
One loyal goon offers a lighter, blissfully unaware of the horrors unfolding inside.
Inside the container, desperate thuds shake the massive steel lock mechanism.
The mafia boss puffs his cigarette, slightly amused by all the clumsy racket.
Finally realizing something is terribly wrong, the gangsters hammer frantically on the truck.
A hulking bald thug grabs the metal latches, wrenching the heavy doors open.
Total shock freezes the entire crew as bloody screams spill out into rain.
Tae's partner gets pulled into the shadows, mauled by ravenous shadows.
The bald enforcer loses his temper, charging headfirst into the blood-soaked trailer.
He delivers a vicious front kick, sending an infected ghoul flying backward.
Slipping a combat blade into his grip, the brute prepares for street warfare.
He drives the cold steel straight through the lung of an incoming creature.
Did that put it down? Not even a flinch.
The junior henchmen freeze in sheer terror, completely paralyzed by the bizarre attack.
Another raving corpse leaps from the dark, completely ignoring standard human survival instincts.
In one brutal snap, razor-sharp fangs tear straight into the bald enforcer's jugular.
Stabbing vital organs doesn't do squat against monsters that are already biologically expired.
The beast's crimson eyes gleam under raindrops as it rips through warm flesh.
Terror erupts through the crew as reality violently smashes their tough-guy facade.
The infected howls into the midnight storm, hungry for fresh prey.
Dripping claws reach toward the trembling gang members huddled in the rain.
But standing right in the downpour, Tae watches the madness unfold without flinching.
That ruthless glare says it all—panic is a luxury dead men can't afford.
Another panicked lackey gets dragged to the wet asphalt, screeching for backup.
Brandishing a wooden baseball bat, a trembling goon backs away slowly.
Cannibals or biological freaks? Tae honestly couldn't care less about their official label.
Tae steps forward calmly, brushing his panicked men aside like annoying flies.
Polished leather boots splash down in dirty puddles, calculated and completely fearless.
The rabid ghoul feasts on the asphalt, fully distracted by fresh meat.
Tae drops a thunderous curb stomp directly across the monster's arched spinal column.
He looks down with pure irritation, utterly disgusted by the repulsive pest.
Even with a shattered spine, the monstrosity still thrashes against the gravel.
Tae draws a wicked curved blade, deciding it's time for actual surgical precision.
One blinding arc of steel severs the ghoul's head cleanly off its shoulders.
The severed skull thuds against wet asphalt, lifeless and permanently deactivated.
Tae watches coldly as dark fluid mixes into the pouring rain gutters.
Outside, a chilling howl echoes across the lot, signaling reinforcements.
Another shrieking stalker leaps from the roof of the delivery truck.
Tae dodges effortlessly, slamming the incoming beast face-first into concrete.
It snaps feral jaws relentlessly, feeling zero pain from the bone-shattering collision.
Tae asks the snarling ghoul why on earth it refuses to stay deceased.
He answers his own question by stomping its cranium into the pavement.
That wretched screeching was getting annoying anyway.
Another pair of crimson eyes glares through the torrential downpour.
Tae runs a wet hand through his hair and lets out a grim chuckle.
Conventional puncture wounds mean nothing to creatures devoid of functioning circulatory systems.
Severing the nervous system is literally the only language these freaks understand.
A female infected screeches, charging with freakish speed across the pavement.
Tae locks his focus directly on the base of her exposed skull.
He drives the thick hunting knife straight through the back of her neck.
The shrieking instantly cuts out as dead nerve signals violently misfire.
Tae pulls the dripping blade free, maintaining a rock-solid tactical grip.
A shadowy claw swipes millimeters from his temple out of nowhere.
Another rotting fiend lunges aggressively, nearly catching Tae off guard in the darkness.
Hesitating for even half a second out here guarantees an instant grave.
Tae plants his palms against the slick asphalt, pivoting low under the swing.
He whips his entire lower body into a crushing spinning kick.
Heavy leather smashes into decayed bone with the crack of a bat.
The impact sends the beast skidding hard across wet parking lines.
So their bones do shatter under enough kinetic force after all.
Yet another crazed mutant sprints forward, eyes glowing with rabid hunger.
Tae builds instant momentum, sprinting straight toward the incoming nightmare.
He slips past the clumsy swipe, pressing his back against a nearby pillar.
Tae delivers a vicious counterstrike, crushing the beast's skull directly into solid steel.
The battered fiend collapses into a bloody puddle, completely neutralized for good.
Tae tilts his chin upward, letting cool rain wash the filth away.
But as dozens of guttural roars echo across the district, Tae realizes this outbreak has only begun.
